question: What ritual action must follow after worshipping the previously named deities with cloth and other items?
premises: The prior deities have been worshipped with cloth and other offerings.
A group of eight protectors is to be addressed next.
The action must proceed in order.
inference: After worshipping those deities with cloth and other items, one should worship the group of eight protectors in sequence.
plain_english: Having worshipped these deities with cloth and other offerings, one should then worship the group of eight protectors in due order.
